```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false
import ast
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import altair as alt
import itables
from itables import show
import pandas as pd

from pyosmetrics.plot_theme import load_poppins_font, register_and_enable_poppins_theme

pd.options.mode.chained_assignment = None
pd.options.future.infer_string = True

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
load_poppins_font()
register_and_enable_poppins_theme()

package_data_path = Path.cwd().parents[0] / "data" / "package_data.csv"
package_df = pd.read_csv(package_data_path)
package_df["gh_meta"] = package_df["gh_meta"].apply(
    lambda x: ast.literal_eval(x) if isinstance(x, str) else x
)

def gh_count(key):
    return package_df["gh_meta"].apply(
        lambda x: x.get(key) if isinstance(x, dict) else None
    )

package_df["forks_count"] = gh_count("forks_count")
package_df["contrib_count"] = gh_count("contrib_count")
package_df["open_issues_count"] = gh_count("open_issues_count")
package_df["stargazers_count"] = gh_count("stargazers_count")

total_contributors = int(package_df["contrib_count"].fillna(0).sum())
total_forks = int(package_df["forks_count"].fillna(0).sum())
total_stargazers = int(package_df["stargazers_count"].fillna(0).sum())
total_open_issues = int(package_df["open_issues_count"].fillna(0).sum())

# One slot per package so rotated names do not collide.
chart_width = max(1200, len(package_df) * 36)


def package_bar(y_field, y_title, title, color):
    return (
        alt.Chart(package_df)
        .mark_bar(color=color)
        .encode(
            alt.X("package_name", sort="-y")
            .title("Package name")
            .axis(labelAngle=-60, labelOverlap=False, labelLimit=0),
            alt.Y(f"{y_field}:Q").title(y_title),
            href="issue_link:N",
            tooltip=["package_name", y_field, "issue_link"],
        )
        .properties(title=title, width=chart_width, height=420)
    )


def show_packages(df):
    """Link each package name to its software-submission issue."""
    name_column = df.columns.get_loc("package_name")
    link_column = df.columns.get_loc("issue_link")
    link_renderer = itables.JavascriptFunction(
        f"""
        function(data, type, row) {{
            if (type !== "display") return data;

            const link = document.createElement("a");
            link.href = row[{link_column}];
            link.textContent = data;
            link.target = "_blank";
            link.rel = "noopener noreferrer";
            return link.outerHTML;
        }}
        """
    )
    return show(
        df,
        showIndex=False,
        columnDefs=[
            {"targets": name_column, "render": link_renderer},
            {"targets": link_column, "visible": False},
        ],
    )
```

## Row {height=auto}

::: {.card}
This data provides metrics across pyOpenSci packages. Contributor, fork, star, and issue totals add the count from each accepted package. A person who works on more than one package is counted once for each package.
:::

::: {.card title="Detailed pyOpenSci metrics"}
Find below the detailed count for each pyOpenSci repository. Select a package name to open its review issue.

```{python}
show_packages(
    package_df[
        [
            "package_name",
            "forks_count",
            "contrib_count",
            "open_issues_count",
            "stargazers_count",
            "issue_link",
        ]
    ]
)
```
